description: Controlled tiny projects; each expected and candidate module is independently compiled and exported by the official comparator.
challenge:
namespace ComparatorControl
def threshold : Nat := 1
theorem target : threshold = threshold := by sorry
end ComparatorControl

cases.name: matching
cases.source:
namespace ComparatorControl
def threshold : Nat := 1
theorem target : threshold = threshold := rfl
end ComparatorControl

cases.name: statement-mismatch
cases.diagnostic: Challenge and solution theorem statement do not match
cases.source:
namespace ComparatorControl
def threshold : Nat := 1
theorem target : threshold = threshold ∧ True := ⟨rfl, True.intro⟩
end ComparatorControl

cases.name: definition-mismatch
cases.diagnostic: Const does not match between challenge and target 'ComparatorControl.threshold'
cases.source:
namespace ComparatorControl
def threshold : Nat := 2
theorem target : threshold = threshold := rfl
end ComparatorControl

cases.name: forbidden-axiom
cases.source:
namespace ComparatorControl
def threshold : Nat := 1
axiom forbidden : threshold = threshold
theorem target : threshold = threshold := forbidden
end ComparatorControl

cases.name: admitted-proof
cases.source:
namespace ComparatorControl
def threshold : Nat := 1
theorem target : threshold = threshold := by sorry
end ComparatorControl
